description: This file defines a PHP class 'smpl_Invoice_Group_Sample' that generates a PDF invoice template with methods for retrieving invoice type, body content, header, and footer. It references external services and translation functions to build the invoice layout.

classes.name: smpl_Invoice_Group_Sample
classes.description: A PHP class that provides methods to generate invoice PDF content, including header, footer, and body layout with dynamic data placeholders.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of document, which is 'AOS_Invoices'.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML content for the invoice body, including company info, invoice details, and line items.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns an empty string for the header content.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML content for the invoice footer, including page number and date.
